t: 梅克里乌斯成为了教皇约翰二世,第一个在升入教宗后采用新名的教宗.
te: Mercurius becomes Pope John II, the first pope to adopt a new name upon elevation to the papacy.
dz: 梅克里乌斯成为了教皇约翰二世,第一个在升入教宗后采用新名的教宗.
de: Mercurius becomes Pope John II, the first pope to adopt a new name upon elevation to the papacy.

t: 贝利萨里奥斯旗下一支拜占庭远征分舰队从君士坦丁堡出航,经希腊和西西里向非洲万达尔人出击.
te: A Byzantine expeditionary fleet under Belisarios sails from Constantinople to attack the Vandals in Africa, via Greece …
dz: 贝利萨里奥斯旗下一支拜占庭远征分舰队从君士坦丁堡出航,经希腊和西西里向非洲万达尔人出击.
de: A Byzantine expeditionary fleet under Belisarios sails from Constantinople to attack the Vandals in Africa, via Greece and Sicily.

t: 拜占庭帝国的贝利萨里乌斯在北非迦太基附近的阿德德德克米姆战役中击败了盖利默和万达尔人.
te: Belisarius of the Byzantine Empire defeats Gelimer and the Vandals at the Battle of Ad Decimum, near Carthage, North Af…
dz: 拜占庭帝国的贝利萨里乌斯在北非迦太基附近的阿德德德克米姆战役中击败了盖利默和万达尔人.
de: Belisarius of the Byzantine Empire defeats Gelimer and the Vandals at the Battle of Ad Decimum, near Carthage, North Africa.

t: 贝利萨里乌斯手下的拜占庭军队在阿德德德西姆战胜了万达尔人后进入迦太基.
te: The Byzantine army under Belisarius enters Carthage following their victory over the Vandals at Ad Decimum.
dz: 贝利萨里乌斯手下的拜占庭军队在阿德德德西姆战胜了万达尔人后进入迦太基.
de: The Byzantine army under Belisarius enters Carthage following their victory over the Vandals at Ad Decimum.

t: 拜占庭将领贝利萨里乌斯在特里卡马鲁姆战役中击败了由国王盖利默所指挥的万达人.
te: Byzantine general Belisarius defeats the Vandals, commanded by King Gelimer, at the Battle of Tricamarum.
dz: 万达利克会战:拜占庭将领贝利萨里乌斯在特里卡马鲁姆战役中击败了由国王盖利默所指挥的万达人.
de: Vandalic War: Byzantine general Belisarius defeats the Vandals, commanded by King Gelimer, at the Battle of Tricamarum.

dz: 《文摘》是所有罗马法学家法律的伟大汇编,它与一份供法学院使用的新的正式法律教科书《研究所》一起出版.
de: The Digest, the great collection of all Roman jurists' law, is issued together with a new official law textbook for legal schools, The Institutes.
